params.name: Sides
params.description: Number of corners: 3 is a triangle, 4 a square, high counts approach a circle. With an Inner Radius it is the number of star points.

params.name: Radius
params.description: Distance from the center to each outer corner, in world units.

params.name: Inner Radius
params.description: Distance of the inner corners for a star, in world units. 0 makes a regular polygon; above 0 every other corner is pulled to this radius.

params.name: Fill
params.description: true builds a filled shape of triangles fanned from the center; false builds only the outline as edges.

params.name: Center
params.description: Position of the shape's center in world units; the polygon lies flat in the XZ plane through this point.
